profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer Quality Assurance at Transamerica Financial Life In
profile.summary:
*	15+ years of strong experience in Quality Assurance and Software Testing with exposure to all stages of SDLC.
*	Tested various applications developed using Java, Servlets, Applets, Swings, Xml, MQSeries, Hermes JMS, Oracle, VB, and ASP.
*	Expertise in analyzing requirements, design and business rules.
*	Prepared test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, test data, test cases, execution, test scripts, effort estimation, metrics, traceability matrix, bug analysis, and reporting.
*	Experience in ad-hoc, smoke, functional, system, integration, regression, user acceptance, and GUI interface testing of various applications such as web, client/server and data warehouse including black box and white box testing.
*	Experienced in test management tools like qTest, Quality Center, Jira, Bugzilla, Test Director and ClearQuest.
*	Extensively worked with selenium, quick test professional, and win runner for automated testing.
*	Strong experience in database/backend testing using SQL in Oracle, DB2, Sybase, and Postgres.
*	Ability to set-up a test environment, configure and troubleshoot the system under test.
*	11+ years’ experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies.
*	Well experienced in mainframe and UNIX shell scripts in combination with SQL.
*	Good leadership and team-building qualities with analytical, interpersonal, presentational, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
*	Handled business acceptance testing, release planning, and release coordination.
*	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills both in terms of business and system issues. 
*	Managed onsite and offshore QA team coordination.
*	Ability to work independently or as a team member.
*	Strong communication skills coupled with good interpersonal skills to provide solutions in an efficient manner.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer Quality Assurance
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer Quality Assurance at TRANSAMERICA FINANCIAL LIFE IN

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Sr. QA/QE Analyst (Consultant) 
•	Involved in requirement gathering, analysis, and design, and performed end to end testing.
•	Build and execute test strategy, test plan, test cases, test scripts, release regression and test reports for big and small projects of mainframe and web-based applications.
•	Identified and documented defects/system issues using qTest/Jira and assisted in root cause analysis for the timely resolution of defects.
•	Perform gap analysis on requirements, production bugs, project scoping.
•	Participated in creating functional and technical requirements with the business analysts and developers.
•	Created test data in testing environments by conditioning data per scenario identified in test scripts.
•	Implemented and administrated qTest-test management tool.
•	Acts as subject matter expert on a variety of applications like Withdrawals, Loans, and Plan Setup.
•	Mentor and train new and existing employees in QA best practices, as well as tools and techniques.
•	Guide and coach the QA team in the best agile practices.
•	Optimize SQL queries, performed data quality, data management, and data testing strategies.
•	Assist with the research and design tool to refresh data from production to QA database.
•	Good understanding of Indexes, stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
•	Work with peers and management to define all phases of the testing process including smoke, integration, system, functional, regression and UAT testing.
•	Enhanced and executed automated regression tests using UFT and Selenium, Jmeter, Soap UI.
•	Participated in Scrum activities like backlog grooming, sprint planning/review/demo and daily standups.
•	Compile and communicate weekly testing metrics for senior management.

positions.title: Senior QA Analyst
positions.description:
Sr. QA Analyst (Consultant)
•	Developed regression scripts which cover 80 asset classes for Risk Engine using Shell and SQL.
•	Developed MDI regression processes covering 50 nightly batch feeds using Shell and SQL.
•	Developed volume/ capacity/performance tests for multiple Bloomberg batch feed processes.
•	Developed SOAP UI scripts to mock Bloomberg request and response processes.
•	Worked on regression scripts using Selenium for the IA Risk Analytics website Interface.
•	Set up a benchmark for QA standards through the detailed results-oriented testing approach.
•	Involved as a Lead in Agile Scrum Development effort, along with building teams and educating the team members for a scrum team.
•	Leading QA Team to tackle the huge backlog of open defects/issues and worked through the complete Software Development Life Cycle to deliver the projects.
•	Created the test strategy, test plan, test cases, test scripts, test reports for big and small enhancements.
•	Database objects analysis and tuning (tables, indexes, keys, stored procedures).
•	An automated manual testing effort by creating Unix scripts with embedded SQL.
•	Perform analysis of requirements, production bugs, project scoping.
•	Involved in Daily Scrum, project planning meetings.
•	Worked in Unix/Linux using command-line scripts to run the following Java processes: Importer, Mapper, ValuePortfolio, Risk Engine, and Stress Engine.
•	Performed Website Testing on IA (Investor Analytics-Providing RISK transparency Winner of 2010 Best Risk Management Software Supplier) risks analytic website.
•	Extensively worked with Oracle and Postgres database to support and drive testing effort.
•	Develop test summaries, test matrix, test reports.

positions.title: Senior QA Analyst
positions.description:
Sr. QA Analyst (Consultant)
•	Involved in all the stages of software development.
•	Created the test cases, test scripts and test reports for quick development of the small projects.
•	Handled testing support for the upstream application like FOS, REPOS, MasterFiles, and Martini related projects/ changes.
•	Worked extensively in the Unix environment using command line commands and scripts to test the project related changes, as well as identify missing trades for upstream test support.
•	Coordinated and executed large scale custodian migration from Chase to BNYM.
•	Responsible for designing and creating all functional and non-functional testing guidelines for US Treasuries and Treasury Repos across North American Settlements IT.
•	Worked with the test team to run a Production Parallel (mock) test which was unique in its own in the UBS development environment.
•	Extensively worked with Oracle and Sybase database to support upstream and fixed income testing.
•	Testing of Fix protocol messages from buy-side and sell-side. Different tags and values from OCC and back-office systems.
•	Developed test summaries, test matrix, test reports.
•	Working in Mercury Quality Central to track the defects in the testing environment.
•	Handled daily test support activities to handle the test environment for other projects.

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Senior QA Analyst (Consultant)
•	Worked through a complete QA life cycle using Agile/Scrum project methodology.
•	Created the user stories (requirements), verified the code in development, tested the code in test and worked with the users in all phases.
•	Created agile DTP, test summaries at sprint level and release level.
•	Analyzed user requirements and interacted with system architects, developers, and business users.
•	Tested the transformation and load process (ETL) for loan servicing and data warehouse from their legacy systems using ab initio and provided technical support and hands-on mentoring in the use of Ab Initio.
•	Extensively used MS SQL server’s query analyzer to verify the ETL process and end to end testing of the source data with the target data.
•	Performed white box testing.
•	Used Unix shell scripts to perform the testing on ab initio graphs.
•	Worked on Oracle PL/SQL to run various, complex queries.
•	Developed test plans, test cases, and test script using the Test Director.
•	Executed the regression test suite scripts in the database.
•	Performed functionality, regression, and data-driven testing for various data.
•	Tested the data in web-based application titan on various browsers.
•	Attended change request meetings to document changes and implemented procedures to test changes.
•	Prepared test cases to test the backend database by retrieving the data for the tables using SQL.
•	Reported the bugs, email notifications to the developers using the test director.
•	Participated in walk troughs and defect report meetings periodically.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Software Consultant 
•	Created test cases and test procedures based on the documentation with the intent of finding as many errors as possible
•	Performed integration, end-to-end testing, and user acceptance testing, back-end testing and the corresponding process of migration with test cases and test scripts for the functionality testing.
•	Verified the bugs fixed by developers during each phase of testing such as white-box testing and black-box testing.
•	Tested for data integrity and consistency.
•	Analyzed the ab initio graph error log files to find out the specific error if the graph fails.
•	Verified the positive testing and negative testing.
•	Balanced all the counts and balances of account files in different stages of data migration -- source, pre ab initio, post ab initio, data load to the data warehouse in an oracle database.
•	Used Unix shell scripts for batch processing for ab initio graph parameters.
•	Identified and documented the defects in the test director.
•	Developed test cases and tested client-side scripts, server-side scripts, and the user interface 
•	Executed test cases, procedures, and scripts for the assigned areas to verify the functionality conducted web browser compatibility testing using different browsers and versions on multiple platforms.
•	Overall test management with test director including requirement analysis.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
•	Involved in data mapping, Porting, preparing, importing and troubleshooting process.
•	Recreated and Developed screens, customized views, business objectes, and components.
•	Reproduces various reports in Actuate.
•	Provided documentation on Siebel including data mapping in the EIM process.
•	Studied & analyzed business requirement, core process, and interface requirements and prepare the detailed design.
•	Configured Applets, Multi Value Links, Multi-Value Fields, join fields, Pick Applets and Pick Lists.

positions.title: System Analyst/Programmer
positions.description:
•	Worked on data mapping, porting, preparing, importing and troubleshooting process
•	configuration- recreated and developed goldmine screens, views customized business objects and components with relevant applets, views, and screens
•	Worked on actuate reports to reproduce various goldmine reports and documentation
•	Studied & analyzed business requirements, core processes and interface requirements to customize business objects, business components, views and screens
•	Changed some of the vanilla Siebel applets to cater to the business requirements
•	Set up visibility by defining organizational structure, responsibilities, and positions
•	Modified existing and created new reports by using actuate for business requirements
•	Involved in the testing and documentation of the customized application

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
•	Analyzed and prepared the user and business requirements and interacted with users, developers and business users. 
•	Developed application by coding different modules using Developer 2000.
•	Designed and developed the Forms, Reports, and Graphs and tested them by unit testing/module testing.
•	Executed UAT and implemented the system testing in various departments.
•	Responsible for updating weekly status which shows the progress of the application 
•	Involved in User Acceptance Testing and implementing the system in various departments.

positions.title: Junior “C” Programmer
positions.description:
•	As a team member, I was working in the product team of R & D Department and the team was led by the production manager. 
•	My job was to develop & maintain system software for the product. The work environment was LAN & Widows'95 as a platform & software used is Turbo - C. 
•	The Company pioneers in manufacturing its own designed electronics products for national & International textiles industries. The various products are Evenness Tester, EYC (Electronically Yarn Clearer), UT3 (Uster Testers) Etc. Since the company has its own hardware & software design which is handled by the R & D Department.
